name: Molo
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

sources.citation: Starostin, George. 2015. Annotated Swadesh wordlists for the Jebel group (East Sudanic family). Global Lexicostatistical Database (Moscow), text version 18/08/2015, 38 pp.
sources.note: Secondary compilation of Bender 1997's Molo/Aka/Kelo/Beni Sheko lists. 'Transcription' notes (pp. 3-4) cover consonant symbols, vowel length and (for Gaam) tone marking; nothing is said about stress or accent in Aka/Molo/Kelo. Bender's sporadic stress marks are simply carried over in the data: Molo gˈiɲɔ 'louse', ˈaguwa 'moon', bˈiːdi 'sun', mukˈʋm 'year' (4 of ~100 Molo items; 3 initial, 1 final) -- no rule stated.

sources.citation: Stirtz, Timothy M. 2012. A grammar of Gaahmg, a Nilo-Saharan language of Sudan. Utrecht: LOT (296).
sources.note: About Gaahmg only; Molo mentioned solely in the classification paragraph (p. ~1-2, citing Bender 1998:39). Nothing on Molo prosody. (PDF read in not kept in the molo folder.)
